propositions: the review-bot container lacks AWS region configuration (no AWS_DEFAULT_REGION, AWS_REGION, AWS_PROFILE, or REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION), causing boto3 region resolution to fail silently

build_bedrock_provider passes None as region_name when REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION is unset, triggering pydantic-ai's UserError which is not caught by rebar's LLMError handlers, breaking the fail-closed path
boto3 resolves region ONLY from AWS_DEFAULT_REGION (not AWS_REGION alone) and from config files, never from IMDS; explicit region configuration is independent of instance metadata reachability
the Bedrock cutover hard-fails at client construction with no cross-provider fallback, degrading the entire LLM-Review gate for every landing
CloudWatch voter metrics silently no-op for the same missing-region reason, breaking rollback alarm detection
existing Bedrock probes and runbook all passed region explicitly, masking the ambient resolution defect
